name: Hermes Agent
description: Nous Research 开源的自进化 AI 智能体：7×24 运行在自己的服务器上，可接入 Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp 等消息网关，从经验中沉淀技能。

install.detect: command -v hermes >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes || echo no
install.notice: 将以两个用户态 systemd 服务安装：网关（gateway）与 Web 控制台（dashboard，监听 0.0.0.0:9119，Basic Auth 认证）。请设置 dashboard 登录密码，强度自行保证；无需 sudo。若希望 SSH 退出后服务常驻，请手动执行一次 sudo loginctl enable-linger $USER。

inputs.label: Dashboard 登录密码
inputs.placeholder: 至少 8 位，强度自行保证

steps.name: 下载并安装 Hermes（官方脚本 --non-interactive，自动配置 Python/Node/ripgrep/FFmpeg）
创建网关用户态服务（hermes-gateway，无需 sudo）
steps.command:
U="$HOME/.config/systemd/user/hermes-gateway.service"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$U")"
HERMES_BIN=$(command -v hermes 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/hermes")
cat > "$U" <<UNIT
[Unit]
Description=Hermes Agent Gateway
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=$HERMES_BIN gateway run
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
UNIT
systemctl --user daemon-reload
echo "已创建 $U"

steps.name: 配置 dashboard 认证（~/.hermes/.env，密码与固定会话签名）
创建 dashboard 用户态服务（监听 0.0.0.0:9119）
steps.command:
U="$HOME/.config/systemd/user/hermes-dashboard.service"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$U")"
HERMES_BIN=$(command -v hermes 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/hermes")
cat > "$U" <<UNIT
[Unit]
Description=Hermes Dashboard (user service)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Environment=HERMES_HOME=%h/.hermes
EnvironmentFile=%h/.hermes/.env
ExecStart=$HERMES_BIN dashboard --no-open --host 0.0.0.0 --port 9119
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
UNIT
systemctl --user daemon-reload
echo "已创建 $U"

steps.name: 启动网关与 dashboard 服务并配置常驻
steps.command:
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
systemctl --user reset-failed hermes-gateway.service hermes-dashboard.service 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl --user enable --now hermes-gateway.service || {
  echo '--- hermes-gateway 最近日志 ---'
  journalctl --user -u hermes-gateway -n 40 --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true
  exit 1
}
systemctl --user enable --now hermes-dashboard.service || {
  echo '--- hermes-dashboard 最近日志 ---'
  journalctl --user -u hermes-dashboard -n 40 --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true
  exit 1
}
if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
  sudo -n loginctl enable-linger "$(id -un)" 2>/dev/null && echo '已开启 linger：服务在 SSH 退出后继续运行' || true
else
  echo "提示：如需 SSH 退出后服务常驻，请手动执行一次：sudo loginctl enable-linger $(id -un)"
fi

install.verify: export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"; sleep 5; systemctl --user is-active hermes-gateway hermes-dashboard >/dev/null 2>&1 && curl -sS -o /dev/null -m 8 http://127.0.0.1:9119/api/status && echo ok

ops.start:
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
systemctl --user reset-failed hermes-gateway.service hermes-dashboard.service 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl --user start hermes-gateway.service hermes-dashboard.service
ops.restart:
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
systemctl --user reset-failed hermes-gateway.service hermes-dashboard.service 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl --user restart hermes-gateway.service hermes-dashboard.service
ops.status:
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
raw=$(systemctl --user is-active hermes-gateway 2>/dev/null)
if [ "$raw" = active ] || [ "$raw" = activating ]; then st=running
elif [ "$raw" = failed ]; then st=failed
else st=stopped; fi
pid=$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value hermes-gateway 2>/dev/null)
[ "$pid" = "0" ] && pid=
up=0; mem=0
if [ -n "$pid" ]; then
  up=$(ps -o etimes= -p "$pid" 2>/dev/null | tr -d " ")
  mem=$(ps -o rss= -p "$pid" 2>/dev/null | tr -d " ")
fi
health=fail
if curl -sS -o /dev/null -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:9119/api/status 2>/dev/null; then health=ok; fi
if ss -tln 2>/dev/null | grep -q ':9119 '; then listening=yes; else listening=no; fi
echo "STATUS=$st"
echo "PID=${pid:-0}"
echo "PORT=9119"
echo "UPTIME_SEC=${up:-0}"
echo "MEM_KB=${mem:-0}"
echo "LISTENING=$listening"
echo "HEALTH=$health"
echo "VERSION=$(hermes --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"
ops.openPort:
S=""; sudo -n true 2>/dev/null && S="sudo -n"
p={{.port}}; if command -v firewall-cmd >/dev/null 2>&1 && firewall-cmd --state >/dev/null 2>&1; then $S firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=$p/tcp >/dev/null && $S firewall-cmd --reload >/dev/null && echo "firewalld: opened $p/tcp"; elif command -v ufw >/dev/null 2>&1; then $S ufw allow $p/tcp && echo "ufw: opened $p/tcp"; elif command -v iptables >/dev/null 2>&1; then $S iptables -C INPUT -p tcp --dport $p -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || $S iptables -I INPUT -p tcp --dport $p -j ACCEPT; echo "iptables: opened $p/tcp"; else echo '未找到 firewalld/ufw/iptables，请在云安全组手动放行'; fi
ops.update:
hermes update || exit 1
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
systemctl --user reset-failed hermes-gateway.service hermes-dashboard.service 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl --user restart hermes-gateway.service hermes-dashboard.service

uninstall.name: 停止并注销网关与 dashboard 用户态服务
uninstall.command:
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
systemctl --user disable --now hermes-gateway.service 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl --user disable --now hermes-dashboard.service 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/hermes-gateway.service" "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/hermes-dashboard.service"
systemctl --user daemon-reload 2>/dev/null || true

uninstall.name: 卸载程序（保留 ~/.hermes 数据与 .env 认证配置）
